tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get a public company's Docket Nexus profile by slug (e.g. 'acme-widgets-inc'): name, industry, number of linked cases, verified public-company identity when on the verified roster, and top case types and courts.

slug.description: Docket Nexus company slug, lowercase and hyphenated, as it appears in a /party/<slug>/ URL (e.g. '3m-company').
slug.title: Slug

tools.name: get_company_cases
tools.description: List public cases linked to a company, newest or oldest first, optionally filtered by nature of suit or court. Paginate with next_cursor. At most 25 per call.

slug.description: Docket Nexus company slug, as used by get_company.
slug.title: Slug

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

sort.description: Order by case filing date. 'newest' (default) or 'oldest'.
sort.title: Sort

nature_of_suit.description: Filter to one nature-of-suit category as shown on the company page (e.g. 'Product Liability').
nature_of_suit.title: Nature Of Suit

court.description: Filter to one court as shown on the company page (e.g. 'District Court, N.D. Alabama').
court.title: Court

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Get a public case by its Docket Nexus URL (https://docketnexus.com/case/.../): caption, court, docket number, dates, judge, cause, nature of suit, parties as shown on the case page, and disposition when recorded.

case_url.description: Full Docket Nexus case URL, e.g. https://docketnexus.com/case/<slug>-<id>/ . Returned as canonical_url by search_cases and get_company_cases.
case_url.title: Case Url

tools.name: get_case_docket
tools.description: List a public case's docket entries newest first, with document availability. Paginate with next_cursor. At most 50 per call. Entries the site does not publish are omitted and only counted.

case_url.description: Full Docket Nexus case URL, as accepted by get_case.
case_url.title: Case Url

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get public metadata for a docket document by its Docket Nexus document id: entry, date, description, page count, availability and parent case. Metadata only; no document text.

document_id.description: Docket Nexus document id, as returned in a get_case_docket entry's document_id field. Metadata only is returned; document text is never served.
document_id.title: Document Id

tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search public cases by caption words, 'A v. B', or a federal docket number WITH its office prefix (e.g. 1:24-cv-01234). Results are newest first, at most 25 per call; paginate with next_cursor.

query.description: Caption words, an 'A v. B' party pairing, or a federal docket number INCLUDING its office prefix (e.g. '1:24-cv-01234'). A docket number without the office prefix is refused.
query.title: Query

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor
